title: "VennDiagram"

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
############################################
## Venn diagram: Bionano, RNAseq, IMPACTseq, WES, WGS
############################################

library(dplyr)
library(VennDiagram)
library(grid)

# ---------- File path ----------
cohort_file <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/pILC_cohort.csv"

# ---------- Read and fix cohort table ----------
cohort_raw <- read.csv(cohort_file,
                       check.names = FALSE,
                       stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# First data row contains the true header
true_header <- as.character(unlist(cohort_raw[1, ]))
colnames(cohort_raw) <- trimws(true_header)

# Drop that header row
cohort <- cohort_raw[-1, ]

# ---------- Clean columns ----------
# Helper to safely trim a column if it exists
trim_col <- function(df, col) {
  if (!col %in% colnames(df)) stop(paste("Missing column in cohort table:", col))
  df[[col]] <- trimws(as.character(df[[col]]))
  df
}

cohort <- cohort %>%
  trim_col("Sample") %>%
  trim_col("Bionano") %>%
  trim_col("RNAseq") %>%
  trim_col("IMPACTseq") %>%
  trim_col("WES") %>%
  trim_col("WGS")

# ---------- Define sets for each modality ----------
bionano_samples <- cohort$Sample[cohort$Bionano   == "Y"]
rna_samples     <- cohort$Sample[cohort$RNAseq    == "Y"]
impact_samples  <- cohort$Sample[cohort$IMPACTseq == "Y"]
wes_samples     <- cohort$Sample[cohort$WES       == "Y"]
wgs_samples     <- cohort$Sample[cohort$WGS       == "Y"]

venn_list <- list(
  Bionano   = bionano_samples,
  RNAseq    = rna_samples,
  IMPACTseq = impact_samples,
  WES       = wes_samples,
  WGS       = wgs_samples
)

venn_plot <- venn.diagram(
  x = venn_list,
  filename = NULL,   # IMPORTANT
  fill = c("#1b9e77", "#F8766D", "#7CAE00", "#00BFC4", "#C77CFF"),
  alpha = 0.5
)

```


```{r}
# ---------- Draw Venn diagram ----------
venn_plot <- venn.diagram(
  x = venn_list,
  filename = NULL,
  main = "pILC multi-omics overlap",
  main.cex = 1.5,
  fill = c("#1b9e77", "#F8766D", "#7CAE00", "#00BFC4", "#C77CFF"),
  alpha = 0.5,
  disable.logging = TRUE,   # no log file
  cex = 1.1,
  cat.cex = 1.15,
  cat.col = "black",
  cat.pos = 0,
  cat.dist = 0.05,
  margin = 0.1,
  col = "black",
  lwd = 1,
  imagetype = "png",
  background = "white"
)

grid.newpage()
grid.draw(venn_plot)

# ---------- Save as PNG ----------
png("pILC_multiomics_venn_5set.png", width = 2600, height = 2600, res = 300, bg = "white")
grid.newpage()
grid.draw(venn_plot)
dev.off()

# ---------- Save as PDF ----------
pdf("pILC_multiomics_venn_5set.pdf", width = 7.5, height = 7.5, bg = "white")
grid.newpage()
grid.draw(venn_plot)
dev.off()

```

```{r}
# ---------- Sanity check: number of samples per modality ----------
cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("Sample counts per modality\n")
cat("==============================\n")

modality_counts <- sapply(venn_list, length)

print(modality_counts)

cat("\nTotal unique samples across all modalities:\n")
print(length(unique(unlist(venn_list))))
```
